verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented end-to-end voice latency figures, benchmarks, or latency-tuning guidance. The turn-detection and adaptive-interruption docs cover turn-taking behavior, not latency numbers or tuning for speed. A community report also notes there was no way to measure latency across STT → LLM → TTS, which reinforces the absence of latency documentation.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented end-to-end voice latency numbers or tuning guidance backing the platform's speed claims
